svg.text: Bella Vita 2 · Floor 1 (floors 2 and 3 identical) · Plan B luxury (TV + sofa where they fit)
Plan B luxury: shared 42" TV in each twin room; Flipper sofa + 42" TV in ROOM-3; 40" TV facing the bed in ROOM-4.
Wakefit kit (W × D): Centaur single bed 7'-0" × 3'-5⅜" · Orion queen bed 7'-3⅞" × 5'-3¼" · Tinker side table 1'-4⅞" × 0'-11¾"
Twill wardrobe 1'-11⅝" × 1'-6¾" · Cabrera study table 2'-7⅜" × 1'-5¾" · Sage study table (hutch) 3'-3⅜" × 1'-10½"
Flipper 2-seater sofa cum bed 3'-10" × 2'-6" · chair space 2'-5½" (dashed circle). A / B = student
Blue = Wakefit furniture. Students per room: ROOM-1 2, ROOM-2 2, ROOM-3 1, ROOM-4 1 = 6 on this floor. Twin rooms use Centaur singles, single rooms the Orion queen.
Yellow = door swing; every door opens inwards. Light blue on walls = windows.
Red = RCC columns from the structural drawing (Agharkar, rev R1, 02.11.2026), 9" wide on this floor; they stand out of the 6" walls.
Walls, doors and windows from the architect's AFTER O.C. drawing. Furniture positions are proposals.
